title: Jinja wiki templates cannot list accepted Papyrus references
description:
Researcher first-pass. This is the gap that blocks using the wiki as the live research KB.

Jinja can query() Kanbus issues but cannot list accepted Papyrus references (JSON files on the standing story, currently WIKI-650fd9/references/*.json). Concept pages cannot stay live with the pod accept list.

Need something like references(status=\"accepted\") (and status=\"pending\") in wiki templates so compiled /workspace/research-wiki is not required.

Papyrus refs are not board cards. Do not invent issue records for them. The wiki engine should read story artifact JSON.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Shipped in Kanbus 0.20.0 via PR #172 (list/search/show/lint/check/init, render path, short issue.key, references()). Closing.
